nodes.title: START HERE - KREA 2 ENTITY REFERENCE SHEETS
widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

Krea 2 Entity Reference Sheets - Type-Safe Ref2VA Ready

Every enabled row must start with one routing marker. Use [TPOSE] only for people or genuinely humanoid subjects that have suitable arms and legs. Use [TURNAROUND] for animals, creatures, vehicles, buildings, props, food and everything else. If a marker is accidentally omitted, no pose direction is injected, so the row fails safely rather than forcing an object onto a human body.

  1. Edit the descriptions in panel 1 and leave Prompt Multi in Queue mode.
  2. Edit the one shared style box in panel 2 if desired.
  3. The marker expander inserts exactly one completely separate direction. TURNAROUND prompts never receive face, full-body or T-pose instructions.
  4. Click Run once. [TPOSE] makes a nine-view human/humanoid sheet; [TURNAROUND] makes a reliable six-view object/creature sheet.
  5. Load the PNGs into Ref2VA as ref_image_0, ref_image_1, and so on.

This explicit split prevents cars, sandwiches and creatures from being forced onto invented human bodies.

nodes.title: FINAL PROMPT MONITOR - VERIFY THE SELECTED ROUTE
widgets_values: Create a professional orthographic turnaround reference sheet for exactly one described subject. Use a strict visible two-column by three-row grid containing exactly six separate equal cells. Never merge, enlarge, omit or subdivide a cell. Every cell shows the exact same subject with identical geometry, silhouette, proportions, colours, materials, construction, wear, markings and accessories. Cell 1: complete front view. Cell 2: complete three-quarter front view. Cell 3: complete exact left-side view. Cell 4: complete exact right-side view. Cell 5: complete rear view. Cell 6: the most useful top, plan, underside or identity-detail view for this particular subject. Keep the subject itself complete and uncropped wherever an overall view is requested. Preserve only anatomy explicitly belonging to a described creature. Keep the described subject as the sole subject; never add a wearer, rider, carrier, handler, mannequin or supporting figure. Never anthropomorphize an object. Use a plain warm-grey studio background, soft even lighting, gentle contact shadows and consistent scale. Put a clear black gutter around every cell so all six cells are visibly distinct. No setting, unrelated subjects, alternate designs, labels, captions, text or decorative outer border. A thick farmhouse cheddar sandwich made with two uneven slices of seeded brown bread, mature yellow cheese, a little pickle at the edges, wrapped halfway in creased white paper and secured with blue cotton string, photorealistic production design, physically plausible construction and materials, coherent proportions, neutral colour rendering, crisp identity-defining detail

Create a professional production model sheet for exactly one person or genuinely humanoid subject. The page layout is strict: exactly nine separate equal square panels arranged as three columns by three rows. Never merge, enlarge, omit or subdivide a panel. Every panel shows the exact same identity, facial features, silhouette, proportions, colours, materials, clothing, wear, markings and accessories. Row 1: front face close-up with neutral expression; three-quarter face close-up; exact left-profile face close-up. Row 2, each completely visible head to feet: full-body front neutral stance; full-body three-quarter stance; full-body exact side profile. Row 3: full-body front T-pose facing camera with arms perfectly straight and horizontal and palms down; full-body rear T-pose with arms perfectly straight and horizontal; close-up of the most identity-defining feature or accessory. Use a plain warm-grey studio background, soft even lighting, gentle contact shadows and consistent scale. Put a clear black gutter around every panel. No setting, unrelated subjects, alternate designs, labels, captions, text or decorative outer border.

nodes.title: EDIT THIS - PREFIX EACH ROW [TPOSE] OR [TURNAROUND]

rows.label: ENTITY 1 - [TPOSE] human/humanoid
rows.text: [TPOSE] Mara Vale, a practical woman in her early forties with short dark curls, a narrow scar through her left eyebrow, an olive field jacket, charcoal trousers, worn brown boots, and a brass compass on a red cord

rows.label: ENTITY 2 - [TURNAROUND] creature
rows.text: [TURNAROUND] Brindle, a friendly waist-high six-legged creature with russet fur, broad moth-like ears, two small ivory horns, amber eyes, dark paws, and a faded blue canvas harness with a round copper tag

rows.label: ENTITY 3 - [TURNAROUND] vehicle
rows.text: [TURNAROUND] The Calder Courier, a compact burnt-orange electric delivery van with a high roof, circular headlights, cream steel wheels, a dented left rear door, black roof rails, and a small white lightning emblem on each side

rows.label: ENTITY 4 - [TURNAROUND] food/prop
rows.text: [TURNAROUND] A thick farmhouse cheddar sandwich made with two uneven slices of seeded brown bread, mature yellow cheese, a little pickle at the edges, wrapped halfway in creased white paper and secured with blue cotton string
